prompt: I need 15 new MCQs on neonatal jaundice for the app - single best answer with 5 options and a proper explanation for each one. Make them ready for bulk import and save to Downloads.

assertions.text: Produced a spreadsheet in Downloads with the app's import columns

Every question has an explanation of at least 60 characters

category1 values exactly match app chapter names (e.g. 'Neonatology', 'GIT', 'Haematology')
